articles.title: Analysts split on whether Bitcoin's surge past key levels signals a new bull run
articles.snippet: Market watchers say sudden sharp price spikes and forced short liquidations are the classic signs of a bottom, though macro risks still remain.

articles.title: The hard truth is that the Clarity Act is an anti-crypto bill
articles.snippet: After years of stalled bills, misguided enforcement, and catastrophic collapses, almost any comprehensive crypto legislation began to look like progress. But Clarity is turning that hunger for progress into a political trap, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

articles.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
articles.snippet: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

articles.title: A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
articles.snippet: An options trader opened a large straddle on XRP, betting on wild price swings by Aug. 28.

articles.title: Bitcoin seeks support near $77K as BTC, gold near 100-day highs
articles.snippet: Bitcoin volatility eased after BTC hit its highest level since mid-May, while gold joined the cryptocurrency in approaching three-month highs.
